title: Deutscher AnwaltSpiegel explores the potential of Germany’s Commercial Courts
summary: In an interview with Deutscher AnwaltSpiegel, Vice President Luca Weskott discusses the early development of Germany’s Commercial Courts, describing them as a promising step toward strengthening Germany’s position as a forum for complex commercial disputes. Learn more.
body_markdown:
In an interview with *Deutscher AnwaltSpiegel* , Vice President[Luca Weskott](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/luca-weskott/) discusses the early development of Germany’s Commercial Courts, describing them as a promising step toward strengthening Germany’s position as a forum for complex commercial disputes.


Read the full article[here](https://www.deutscheranwaltspiegel.de/disputeresolution/commercial-courts/commercial-courts-vielversprechend-aber-noch-kein-marktstandard-162674/) .
